Pull the estimate table out of a set of estimator results

tie_estimate_tables.Rd

Internal. Validates that the inputs look like estimator results, are named, and share their cell columns.

Usage

tie_estimate_tables(results, estimator = c("ind", "agg"), boot = FALSE)

Arguments

results

a named list of results from network_survival_estimator()

estimator

"ind" or "agg"

boot

pull the replicate-level table instead of the summary

Value

a named list of tibbles
